over the last decades.

over the world, you always have a competent expert to talk to. Just get in touch.

over the last decades.

industry][124]. Together, we contribute to better nutrition and health. And with local branches all

[Meatless hybrid]

## The next step in meat innovation is hybrid

Combining Meatless^{®} ingredients with meat can improve taste and texture, reduce costs and add
nutritional value.

## BENEO’s Sweet Box

Discover how BENEO’s Sweets Box brings confectionery innovation to life. Featuring concepts for hard
candies, chewing gum, gummies and cotton candy, it showcases the potential of Isomalt, Palatinose™
and functional fibres.

[Read more in our blog][139]

# BENEO – Together we contribute to better nutrition and health

The expectations regarding nutritional choices and functionalities of food have drastically grown
over the last decades.

BENEO is your global partner in catering to the [latest trends and developments in the food and feed
industry][124]. Together, we contribute to better nutrition and health. And with local branches all
over the world, you always have a competent expert to talk to. Just get in touch.

Consumers actively choose foods that contribute to their well-being. Even more, products that match
their individual lifestyles are on [trend][125]. As the demand for convenient and easy to prepare
food continues, the expectations on nutrition also continue to grow. To name just a few, these
include the [reduction of sugar][126] and fat without compromising on taste and texture, increased
dietary fibre intake, plus a need for [healthier weight][127] and [energy management][128].

Farmers, breeders as well as livestock or pet owners on the other hand foster increasingly higher
expectations on the nutritional quality of their feed products. They expect targeted feed, aqua and
pet food that provides their animals with the right amount of nutrients.

BENEO’s [ingredients][129] can be applied to a wide variety of food applications: from beverages to
baby food, bakery, confectionery, cereals, soups and sauces. We also supply ingredients for
different kinds of [animal nutrition][130], ranging from cattle feed to cat food.

[Meatless hybrid]

## The next step in meat innovation is hybrid

Combining Meatless^{®} ingredients with meat can improve taste and texture, reduce costs and add
nutritional value.

# Texture that transforms every bite

See how our collaborative approach turns concepts into next-level sensory experiences

[Explore texture innovations][1]

Mobile Image

## Formulate with our versatile ingredient solutions that help you exceed consumer expectations for
## amazing taste and better nutrition

Ingredion is your ideal partner in developing the future of food, empowering you to create consumer
preferred products that offer exceptional eating experiences with the on-trend benefits they desire.

### Unlock consumer-preferred sweet taste without artificial sweeteners

New PureCircle Clean Taste Solubility Solution (CTSS) is a patented technology offering improved
taste performance, cleaner labels and is 100 times more soluble than Reb M.

[Learn more][2]

[Picture 1118121461]

We can also help you accelerate your sustainability initiatives with our tailored ESG solutions
specific to food and beverage manufacturers. Ingredion's sustainable innovation and regenerative
agriculture practices deliver unmatched, [industry-leading sustainability results][3] that help
propel our customers in meeting their environmental, social and governance commitments.

### Measurably advance your ESG outcomes

**How Ingredion can help:**
* Collaborate to identify and prioritize your sustainability initiatives because what matters to
  you, matters to us
* Help execute on your ESG goals, measure progress and report meaningful advancements to your
  stakeholders
* Sustainably deliver products with the taste, texture and benefits consumers prefer

[Learn more][4]

[Picture 735315543]

## Our expertise

Ingredion is much more than a supplier. A partnership with us will enable you to increase speed to
market with high-quality, value-added products that consumers want.

[none, Picture]

### Nutrition, health and wellness

Our portfolio of science-backed solutions for enhancing nutrition, delivering health benefits and
enabling wellness lifestyle choices is designed to help brands and manufacturers deliver winning
consumer products.

[Learn more][5]

[Glasses of Bubble Tea]

### Sugar reduction

With our unmatched technical expertise, we enable customers to make the most of our robust portfolio
and deliver best-in-class reduced-sugar formulations that win in the market.

[Learn more][6]

[Clean and simple condiments with garnishes]

### Clean and simple ingredients

We combine pioneering solutions and proprietary market insights with formulation
expertise—delivering the cleaner ingredients and simpler labels that consumers understand and
prefer.

[Learn more][7]

[Sliced, stacked, chocolate covered protein bars]

### Plant-based proteins

We bring our extensive portfolio of sustainable plant-protein solutions and formulation expertise to
help customers bring products with consumer-preferred taste, texture and nutrition to market.

[Learn more][8]

[Overhead shot of various pastries]

### Flavorings with Modifying Properties

Ingredion’s consultative taste solution helps food and beverage manufacturers enhance and balance
flavors while solving better-for-you product challenges.

[Learn more][9]

[Texturants]

### Texturants and texture solutions

We combine our 100+ years of texturant know-how with our passion for food science and broadest
portfolio of texturizing solutions to help manufacturers achieve their formulation needs.

[Learn more][10]

[Supermarket aisle view from behind a red-handled shopping cart, surrounded by shelves stocked with
colorful grocery products. Clean, shiny floor and bright lighting, with a shopper visible in the
distance]

### Less mystery, more meaning: Clean labels win consumer preference

Discover how grocery shopping decisions are evolving. Ingredion’s latest research highlights key
trends in health, clean label claims and generational preferences shaping the future of food and
beverage

[View insights][11]

### Strengthen your nutrition, health and wellness strategy

It all starts with the right ingredients. Download our selection guide to see how we can help you
create food and beverages with the right combination of features and benefits to delight today's
consumers.

[Download guide][12]

[Picture 698766832, Picture]

### Technical documents and samples

Explore our comprehensive portfolio of products, order samples and download technical documentation
directly.

[Explore ingredients][13]

## Balance nutrition with taste and texture consumers crave

Just imagine what you could do with a global portfolio of nutrition, health and wellness
capabilities at your fingertips. Here is just a taste of the possibilities across categories we
serve.

[Bakery]

#### Bakery

Leverage a range of ingredient solutions from Ingredion in your Bakery application to deliver
texture, sweetness, label appeal, nutrition and more.

[Explore bakery][14]

[Dairy]

#### Dairy

Deliver the dairy and plant-based dairy alternatives your consumers want with deep formulation
knowhow and Ingredion's broad portfolio of ingr

[ FAQ ][89]

What is Albendazole?

Albendazole is an anti-parasitic active ingredient widely used as veterinary medicine to treat pets
and livestock against internal parasites. Veterinary doctors prefer to treat internal parasitical
problems caused by roundworms, pinworms, tapeworms, and liver flukes with Albendazole. But it is
ineffective against external parasites. It is administered orally in the form of tablets, pills, or
oral suspensions. However, it is to be noted that Albendazole is not used against agricultural and
household pests. Albendazole was developed in 1975. It is on the World Health Organization's List of
Essential Medicines for animals.

What animal diseases can abendazole be used for?

Albendazole is anthelmintic for veterinary use in cattle, sheep, goats, swine, camels, dogs, cats,
elephants, and poultry. It is a medication that is widely used for the treatment of a variety of
parasitic worm infestations. Although Albendazole is mainly used in cattle and sheep, it is found
effective in cats and dogs as well. It is also used in ratite birds and swine to flagellate
parasites and tapeworms.

Can albendazole be used to treat human diseases?

Albendazole is a medical drug administered as an effective treatment for infections caused by
flatworms, tapeworms, hookworms, etc. in humans. Albendazole is effective in treating many diseases.
It is FDA-approved for treating hydatid disease caused by dog tapeworm larvae and neurocysticercosis
caused by pork tapeworm larvae.

What are the benefits of albendazole for human health?

Albendazole is an anthelmintic or anti-worm medication. It is administered to prevent newly hatched
insect larvae (worms) from growing or multiplying in the human body. Albendazole is used to treat
certain infections caused by worms such as pork tapeworm. Albendazole is effective if taken after
eating sufficient food

[ FAQ ][89]

What is Albendazole?

Albendazole is an anti-parasitic active ingredient widely used as veterinary medicine to treat pets
and livestock against internal parasites. Veterinary doctors prefer to treat internal parasitical
problems caused by roundworms, pinworms, tapeworms, and liver flukes with Albendazole. But it is
ineffective against external parasites. It is administered orally in the form of tablets, pills, or
oral suspensions. However, it is to be noted that Albendazole is not used against agricultural and
household pests. Albendazole was developed in 1975. It is on the World Health Organization's List of
Essential Medicines for animals.

What animal diseases can abendazole be used for?

Albendazole is anthelmintic for veterinary use in cattle, sheep, goats, swine, camels, dogs, cats,
elephants, and poultry. It is a medication that is widely used for the treatment of a variety of
parasitic worm infestations. Although Albendazole is mainly used in cattle and sheep, it is found
effective in cats and dogs as well. It is also used in ratite birds and swine to flagellate
parasites and tapeworms.

Can albendazole be used to treat human diseases?

Albendazole is a medical drug administered as an effective treatment for infections caused by
flatworms, tapeworms, hookworms, etc. in humans. Albendazole is effective in treating many diseases.
It is FDA-approved for treating hydatid disease caused by dog tapeworm larvae and neurocysticercosis
caused by pork tapeworm larvae.

What are the benefits of albendazole for human health?

Albendazole is an anthelmintic or anti-worm medication. It is administered to prevent newly hatched
insect larvae (worms) from growing or multiplying in the human body. Albendazole is used to treat
certain infections caused by worms such as pork tapeworm. Albendazole is effective if taken after
eating sufficient food

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a result, we have grown into leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers over the years. With the
goodwill and trust of our customers, the best is yet to come!

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a result, we have grown into leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers over the years. With the
goodwill and trust of our customers, the best is yet to come!

[[flag][flag]

### Athens, Greece

With more than 3,000 sqm of R&D facilities, our team in Athens specialises in the development of
Value Added Medicines and has been recently upgraded with HPAPI capabilities.

⟶][121]
[[flag][flag]

### Halden, Norway

Halden is one of the largest and most advanced sterile production facilities in Northern Europe. It
specialises in the production and distribution of IV bags and plastic ampoules using Blow-Fill Seal
(BFS) technology.

⟶][122]
[[flag][flag]

### Jura, Switzerland

We provide a complete range of services tailored to both Clinical Manufacturing and Commercial
Manufacturing needs, and we specialise in small-batch production with a customised approach.  

⟶][123]
[[flag][flag]

### Kawagoe, Japan

Our state-of-the-art manufacturing site specialises in ampoules, tablets and visual inspection
services. We offer excellent customer service in English and Japanese. It has one of the largest
cold storage warehouses in Japan.

⟶][124]
[[flag][flag]

### Livron, France

With over 100 years of experience, Adragos Livron focuses on sterile liquids and suppositories
manufacturing. We handle more than 100 molecules and provide stability studies, narcotics handling
and analytical testing services.

⟶][125]
[[flag][flag]

### Leipzig, Germany

Our manufacturing facility in Leipzig specialises in semi-solid and non-sterile liquid
pharmaceuticals. With over 100 years of experience, we have a track record of providing first-class
service and customer-focused manufacturing.

⟶][126]
[[flag][flag]

### Maisons-Alfort, France

At our facility in France, we manufacture sterile prefilled syringes and liquid or lyophilised
vials.
With high-speed aseptic filling, freeze-drying, and integrated packaging, the site uses
GMP-compliant CIP/SIP and RABS technologies to ensure quality and reliable global supply.

## Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Ltd.: Leading the Way in Pharma Manufacturing

▼

Akums Drugs & Pharmaceuticals Ltd. stands as India’s largest and most trusted Contract Development
and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), redefining pharmaceutical excellence through innovation,
quality, and efficiency. As a preferred partner for leading pharmaceutical and healthcare companies
worldwide, Akums is committed to delivering groundbreaking formulations that meet evolving market
needs.

With 15+ state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities, Akums offers unmatched expertise across diverse
therapeutic segments and dosage forms, including tablets, capsules, injectables, soft gels, syrups,
topicals, nutraceuticals, cosmeceuticals, derma solutions etc. Our robust R&D capabilities drive
innovation, ensuring fast, cost-effective product development that aligns with stringent regulatory
standards.

Akums is also a trusted leader in Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) manufacturing, ensuring a
seamless and high-quality supply of essential raw materials for pharmaceutical formulations. Our API
capabilities are in compliance with international regulatory standards, supporting the development
of superior formulations while enhancing supply chain reliability for our partners.

Quality at Akums is more than a benchmark—it is a culture. We adhere to global regulatory standards,
including WHO-GMP, USFDA, EU-GMP, and TGA, ensuring that every product meets the highest safety and
efficacy standards. Our advanced Quality Management System (QMS) and compliance-driven approach
reinforce our leadership in pharmaceutical manufacturing.

Akums collaborates with 1500+ pharmaceutical companies, manufacturing over 4100+ commercialized
formulations. Our expertise extends beyond manufacturing to include formulation development,
technology transfers, regulatory support, and customized solutions, helping brands expand their
portfolios and market presence seamlessly.

While innovation fuels our growth, sustainability shapes our future. Akums integrates eco-friendly
initiatives and energy-efficient manufacturing processes, ensuring responsible business operations
that contribute to a healthier planet.

Leading the Make in India initiative, Akums continues to revolutionize global healthcare by
providing high-quality, innovative pharmaceutical solutions with a patient-first approach,
strengthening its position as a driving force in the industry.

Journey

## A story of helping fight diseases better

[See our entire journey][139]
1907
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey beginning in 1907]

Started manufacturing tinctures and alcohol at Vadodara

1940
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1940]

Began production of cough syrups, vitamins, tonics and sulphur drugs

1961
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1961]

Inaugurated Penicilin plant with Lal Bahadur Shastri in attendance

1967
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1967]

Initiated bulk manufacturing of Vitamin B12

1971
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1971]

Manufactured Erythromycin for the first time in Indian history

1972
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1972]

Launched Althrocin, a brand of Erythromycin

1997
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1997]

Althrocin moves to become top selling brand in India

1999
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1999]

Kickstarted the production of synthetic, organic API

2000
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2000]

Received ISO 14000 certification for facilities at Vadodara

2001
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2001]

Began production of Cephalosporin C

2007
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2007]

Acquired non-oncology business of M/s Dabur Pharma Ltd.

2009
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2009]

Addressed chronic therapies through multiple marketing divisions

2011
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2011]

Demerged from Alembic group to form Alembic Pharmaceutical Ltd, and gets listed

2012
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2012]

Unveiled the Dematology division in domestic market with 8 products

2013
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2013]

Started first NDA with a partner and commenced filing in EU, Australia and Brazil

2015
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2015]

Launched Aripiprazole and established the US Front-end as also transitioning to in-house marketing
in the US

2016
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2016]

Struck a JV with Orbicular – Aleor Dermaceutical Limited to develop dermatology products for the
international market

2017

[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Inaugurated the manufacturing facility for Oncology medicines, including oral solids and liquid
injectable vials, in the presence of the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Gujarat, Shri. Vijay Rupani

2017
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Acquired Orit Laboratories LLC, USA

2018
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2018]

Received FDA approvals for Aleor’s dermatology facility

2019
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2019]

Granted approvals for Oncology oral solid facility

Entered a JV to foray into the China market

2020
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2020]

Achieved the milestone of US$ 250 million sales in the US frontend

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and
## commercialising medicines that transform the lives of patients & their families around the world.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

[READ MORE][89]

### [Amryt Compliance][90]
### [Aegerion Consent Decree][91]

## Advocacy

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

[READ MORE][92]

## Join us

This is an exciting time for Amryt Pharma. We are a successful, thriving global company poised to
achieve unparalleled results. Our success is driven and defined by the inspiring people who embody
our values and wake up every day with the goal of changing lives of people with rare and
debilitating diseases.

[GET IN TOUCH][93]

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and
## commercialising medicines that transform the lives of patients & their families around the world.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

[READ MORE][89]

### [Amryt Compliance][90]
### [Aegerion Consent Decree][91]

## Advocacy

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

[READ MORE][92]

## Join us

This is an exciting time for Amryt Pharma. We are a successful, thriving global company poised to
achieve unparalleled results. Our success is driven and defined by the inspiring people who embody
our values and wake up every day with the goal of changing lives of people with rare and
debilitating diseases.

[GET IN TOUCH][93]

# Ending drug shortages with advanced biosynthesis

[Image of a flower]

### Nature is our most powerful source of medicine

While nature has provided the foundation for modern medicine, it wasn’t designed to meet the scale
and demand of 21st century healthcare needs. Today’s pharmaceutical supply chains are largely
reliant on fragile agricultural sources with low predictability, resulting in drug shortages that
ultimately impact patient care.

## Nature is our most powerful source of medicine

While nature has provided the foundation for modern medicine, it wasn’t designed to meet the scale
and demand of 21st century healthcare needs.

Today’s pharmaceutical supply chains are largely reliant on fragile agricultural sources with low
predictability, resulting in drug shortages that ultimately impact patient care.

## We manufacture essential medicines

Antheia’s biosynthesis platform leverages advanced manufacturing technologies to produce
biosynthetic Key Starting Materials (KSMs) and Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs) for
essential medicines in a more efficient, agile, and sustainable approach. Advanced biosynthesis will
transform pharmaceutical supply chains and unlock new opportunities in drug development and
discovery.

[ See Our Pipeline ][24]

### A revolutionary alternative to legacy approaches

The USDA cites that 40% of Western drugs are derived from plants. These medicines are sourced in an
agricultural process that is typically inefficient, inflexible, and highly susceptible to climate
events, inconsistent soil health, pests, and diseases. We need a more efficient, sustainable, and
reliable approach than legacy agricultural-based sources.

### Supply Chain

Agricultural sources can have unpredictable yields. Manufacturing in contained fermentation
environments offers a more reliable, controlled, and consistent supply.

### Resource Utilization

Agricultural-based manufacturing is inefficient and expensive. Purpose-built biomanufacturing
facilities reduce the need for agricultural sourcing and the associated costs, environmental
impacts, and long timelines.

### Novel Solution

Chemical synthesis is not suitable for KSMs and APIs of greater complexity. Advanced biosynthesis –
the leading 21st century technology – enables efficient biomanufacturing of pharma ingredients of
unprecedented complexity.

### Setting a new standard for pharma manufacturing

specialized metabolism to leading industrial programs in metabolic engineering and drug discovery.

across three countries, he values the diverse perspectives that drive innovation and help us turn

scientist, R&D at Codexis. Chris holds a PhD in organic chemistry from McGill University.

[Image of a flower]

### Nature is our most powerful source of medicine

While nature has provided the foundation for modern medicine, it wasn’t designed to meet the scale
and demand of 21st century healthcare needs. Today’s pharmaceutical supply chains are largely
reliant on fragile agricultural sources with low predictability, resulting in drug shortages that
ultimately impact patient care.

## Nature is our most powerful source of medicine

While nature has provided the foundation for modern medicine, it wasn’t designed to meet the scale
and demand of 21st century healthcare needs.

Today’s pharmaceutical supply chains are largely reliant on fragile agricultural sources with low
predictability, resulting in drug shortages that ultimately impact patient care.

## We manufacture essential medicines

Antheia’s biosynthesis platform leverages advanced manufacturing technologies to produce
biosynthetic Key Starting Materials (KSMs) and Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs) for
essential medicines in a more efficient, agile, and sustainable approach. Advanced biosynthesis will
transform pharmaceutical supply chains and unlock new opportunities in drug development and
discovery.

[ See Our Pipeline ][24]

### A revolutionary alternative to legacy approaches

The USDA cites that 40% of Western drugs are derived from plants. These medicines are sourced in an
agricultural process that is typically inefficient, inflexible, and highly susceptible to climate
events, inconsistent soil health, pests, and diseases. We need a more efficient, sustainable, and
reliable approach than legacy agricultural-based sources.

### Supply Chain

Agricultural sources can have unpredictable yields. Manufacturing in contained fermentation
environments offers a more reliable, controlled, and consistent supply.

### Resource Utilization

Agricultural-based manufacturing is inefficient and expensive. Purpose-built biomanufacturing
facilities reduce the need for agricultural sourcing and the associated costs, environmental
impacts, and long timelines.

### Novel Solution

Chemical synthesis is not suitable for KSMs and APIs of greater complexity. Advanced biosynthesis –
the leading 21st century technology – enables efficient biomanufacturing of pharma ingredients of
unprecedented complexity.

### Setting a new standard for pharma manufacturing

## Explore Our Core Ingredients

### [Thickeners][113]

Add texture and body to your recipes naturally. Our plant-based thickeners like guar gum and xanthan
gum are ideal for soups, sauces, gravies, and gluten-free baking.

### [Stabilizers][114]

Keep your emulsions, foams, and frozen treats stable and smooth. Our hydrocolloid stabilizers
prevent separation and ensure consistent results every time.

### [Emulsifiers][115]

Get perfect blends with natural emulsifiers that help oil and water mix beautifully—ideal for
dressings, sauces, and dairy-free recipes.

### [Gelling Agents][116]

Create gels with precision. From firm jelly to elastic textures, our agar agar, carrageenan, and
other gelling agents offer full control.

### [Free Recipe Books][117]

Discover our collection of free recipe books featuring creative uses for thickeners, stabilizers,
and specialty powders. Download instantly and start cooking with confidence.

### [Specialty Powders][118]

Elevate your creations with unique flavor and nutrition. Explore our banana powder, vinegar powder,
and more for chefs and innovators alike.

## Explore Our Core Ingredients

### [Thickeners][113]

Add texture and body to your recipes naturally. Our plant-based thickeners like guar gum and xanthan
gum are ideal for soups, sauces, gravies, and gluten-free baking.

### [Stabilizers][114]

Keep your emulsions, foams, and frozen treats stable and smooth. Our hydrocolloid stabilizers
prevent separation and ensure consistent results every time.

### [Emulsifiers][115]

Get perfect blends with natural emulsifiers that help oil and water mix beautifully—ideal for
dressings, sauces, and dairy-free recipes.

### [Gelling Agents][116]

Create gels with precision. From firm jelly to elastic textures, our agar agar, carrageenan, and
other gelling agents offer full control.

### [Free Recipe Books][117]

Discover our collection of free recipe books featuring creative uses for thickeners, stabilizers,
and specialty powders. Download instantly and start cooking with confidence.

### [Specialty Powders][118]

Elevate your creations with unique flavor and nutrition. Explore our banana powder, vinegar powder,
and more for chefs and innovators alike.

# Plant based ingredients

# Upcycling nature’s gifts into valuable solutions for the food and beverage industry

**Citrus pectin.** A highly versatile and valuable natural dietary fiber, recognised by consumers as
a label-friendly ingredient. It serves as gelling, thickening and stabilising agent in food,
beverages, cosmetics, nutraceuticals and pharma. 

[ Find more ][66]

**Citrus fiber.** A clean label, plant-based ingredient delivering multiple functional and dietary
benefits. It is derived from partially depectinised citrus peels, making it a perfect example of a
circular economy.

[ Find more ][67]

**Tara gum.** A natural ingredient with excellent thickening and stabilising properties. It is
obtained by grinding the seeds of Caesalpinia spinosa, sourced from a sustainable and strictly
controlled supply chain.

[ Find more ][68]

**Tailor-made texturising solutions.** Blends of carefully selected stabilisers, thickeners and
other special ingredients designed to achieve distinctive textures, ensure good stability and
enhance mouthfeel in food and beverages.

[ Find more ][69]

## to devise successful Innovations?

[ Partner with us ][70]

# About JRS Silvateam

JRS Silvateam Ingredients is a fast-growing family of plant-based food ingredients specialists,
reliable partners and problem-solving thinkers, with strong Italian inventiveness, global reach,
passion for sustainability, high quality standards and customer service.
Born from the joint venture between Silvateam and J. Rettenmaier & Söhne, our company boasts a
strong technical expertise, cutting-edge facilities and market oriented vision.
Nurturing passionate, enthusiastic, professional people is a key ingredient to deliver to the
customers tailor-made, label friendly, sustainable solutions helping them to make challenges easier
and future valuable opportunities possible.

# People. Passion. Texture.

Consumers changing expectation is what the food industry must face day by day in order to provide
appealing food and drinks that taste delicious, look good in texture and appearance. Not just
healthy, but also convenient and value for money.
Texture plays a crucial role in influencing consumers’ liking and preference of a food product.
Choosing the right texturiser is a complex task as it requires time-consuming effort and high
investments in research to understand how these ingredients will interact with the other components
of the recipe.
This is what JRS Silvateam Ingredients technicians do in state-of-the-art applications and
development centres, based in Bergamo (Italy) and in the JRS headquarters (Rosenberg, Germany),
passionately working hand in glove with customers to develop the most fitting solutions for their
needs.

# About JRS Silvateam

JRS Silvateam Ingredients is a fast-growing family of plant-based food ingredients specialists,
reliable partners and problem-solving thinkers, with strong Italian inventiveness, global reach,
passion for sustainability, high quality standards and customer service.
Born from the joint venture between Silvateam and J. Rettenmaier & Söhne, our company boasts a
strong technical expertise, cutting-edge facilities and market oriented vision.
Nurturing passionate, enthusiastic, professional people is a key ingredient to deliver to the
customers tailor-made, label friendly, sustainable solutions helping them to make challenges easier
and future valuable opportunities possible.

# People. Passion. Texture.

Consumers changing expectation is what the food industry must face day by day in order to provide
appealing food and drinks that taste delicious, look good in texture and appearance. Not just
healthy, but also convenient and value for money.
Texture plays a crucial role in influencing consumers’ liking and preference of a food product.
Choosing the right texturiser is a complex task as it requires time-consuming effort and high
investments in research to understand how these ingredients will interact with the other components
of the recipe.
This is what JRS Silvateam Ingredients technicians do in state-of-the-art applications and
development centres, based in Bergamo (Italy) and in the JRS headquarters (Rosenberg, Germany),
passionately working hand in glove with customers to develop the most fitting solutions for their
needs.

# Charting our path to sustainability

Our commitment to building a brighter future goes well beyond merely increasing production capacity
or improving existing technologies. It encompasses a dedication to innovation, reducing resource
consumption, boosting efficiency, enhancing environmental performance and improving working
conditions.
JRS Silvateam’s eco-conscious approach prioritises the health, safety and wellbeing of our employees
and stakeholders, steadfast support for social initiatives, responsible environmental stewardship,
all while ensuring the sustainability of our economic performance.

# Unleash innovation at our future events

We invite you to explore our plant-based solutions atupcoming exhibitions, including citrus pectin,
tara solutions.
Taste innovative products and meet our team of experts, who are ready to suggest the most fitting
natural ingredients to enhance your offerings with superior quality and functionality.
Don’t miss this chance to discover how our formulations can add value to your products.

# Plant based ingredients

# Upcycling nature’s gifts into valuable solutions for the food and beverage industry

**Citrus pectin.** A highly versatile and valuable natural dietary fiber, recognised by consumers as
a label-friendly ingredient. It serves as gelling, thickening and stabilising agent in food,
beverages, cosmetics, nutraceuticals and pharma. 

[ Find more ][66]

**Citrus fiber.** A clean label, plant-based ingredient delivering multiple functional and dietary
benefits. It is derived from partially depectinised citrus peels, making it a perfect example of a
circular economy.

[ Find more ][67]

**Tara gum.** A natural ingredient with excellent thickening and stabilising properties. It is
obtained by grinding the seeds of Caesalpinia spinosa, sourced from a sustainable and strictly
controlled supply chain.

[ Find more ][68]

**Tailor-made texturising solutions.** Blends of carefully selected stabilisers, thickeners and
other special ingredients designed to achieve distinctive textures, ensure good stability and
enhance mouthfeel in food and beverages.

## 聚力协同创新，智启医药未来

作为全球制药工业领域重要的产品贸易与信息交流平台，“世界制药机械、包装设备与材料中国展（PMEC
China）”始终致力于向世界展示中国设备制造企业的优质产品与卓越研发实力。同时，众多海外买家亦将 PMEC
视为洞察中国市场的重要窗口。

在制药行业竞争环境愈发剧烈的当下，设备厂商正积极探索新的技术路径拓展第二增长曲线。

为满足业内对于高精度设备日益迫切的需求。2026年，“第十九届世界制药机械、包装设备与材料中国展（PMEC
China 2026）” 将继续邀请优质展商为大家带来优质产品，并携手 “第二十四届世界制药原料中国展” （CPHI
China 2026）打通制药行业产业链，助力制药行业新发展。

视为洞察中国市场的重要窗口。

在制药行业竞争环境愈发剧烈的当下，设备厂商正积极探索新的技术路径拓展第二增长曲线。

China 2026）” 将继续邀请优质展商为大家带来优质产品，并携手 “第二十四届世界制药原料中国展” （CPHI

##### Welcome to the Wageningen University and Research eDepot

This is the Wageningen University and Research eDepot. In this repository we store files for
[Research@WUR][5] (our Current Research Information System), several Documentation databases and
[WUR Library Search][6] (our catalogue). You cannot search this eDepot itself.

Check the [WUR Library website][7] for a complete overview of our services.

Do you want to know more about our eDepot, please contact [servicedesk.facilities@wur.nl][8]

If you are interested in indexing our eDepot items there is a [sitemap][9] available

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

Paracetamol, being the safest & the most affordable Analgesic & Antipyretic drug, is used for
treating fever, flu, body pain and cold.

Our DC provides drum-to-feeder compression/encapsulation solutions that are both economically sound

## Expanding the
## boundaries of accessibility

[slide_innovation]
[slide_patient]
[slide_globally]

At Glenmark, we are shaping the future of global health in a brave new world.

A new world that requires us to formulate bold new ways by relentlessly pursuing a dual mission:
pioneering transformative, innovative, breakthrough therapies that redefine treatment paradigms, and
expanding access to high-quality, essential medicines for underserved patients around the globe.

We unite scientific excellence, responsible execution and commercial agility to effectively address
unmet patient needs of today and proactively anticipate the emerging health needs of tomorrow.

Innovation Fuels Breakthroughs Breakthroughs Unlock Possibilities Possibilities Enhance Lives

Innovation at Glenmark is driven by a clear purpose: to advance differentiated, science-led
therapies that address health conditions and deliver meaningful benefit to patients. Our innovative
portfolio is concentrated across Respiratory, Dermatology, and Oncology – the therapeutic areas
where medical need is significant, science is evolving rapidly, and Glenmark has built deep clinical
and development expertise. 

Our approach to innovation is defined by therapeutic focus, scientific rigor, and global
partnerships, accelerating access to next-generation therapies. By advancing novel and specialty
therapies with clear clinical relevance, we aim to improve patient outcomes while strengthening
Glenmark’s position as a global, innovation-led pharmaceutical company. 

Accessibility is embedded into how we develop, manufacture, and deliver medicines. Through scalable
manufacturing, fair pricing models, and differentiated delivery formats, we work to make
high-quality therapies across diverse healthcare segments, especially in markets where access
remains limited.

## Join Us

At Glenmark, we want talent to build more than a career. We want them to undertake a quest full of

Where chasing breakthroughs is part of the everyday and shaping the future of global health the

Where we live, breathe and deliver innovation while also expanding accessibility to high-quality
products for patients around the world.

×

are fraudulently offering jobs via certain websites/or through telephone calls, SMS or fake letters
and asking the prospective job aspirants to appear for a face-to-face interview for a job opening
with Glenmark and/or to pay a fee for securing a job with Glenmark. We wish to caution the public
that Glenmark does not collect any monies or any other valuables as a pre or post-employment
requirement.

Innovation at Glenmark is driven by a clear purpose: to advance differentiated, science-led
therapies that address health conditions and deliver meaningful benefit to patients. Our innovative
portfolio is concentrated across Respiratory, Dermatology, and Oncology – the therapeutic areas
where medical need is significant, science is evolving rapidly, and Glenmark has built deep clinical
and development expertise. 

Our approach to innovation is defined by therapeutic focus, scientific rigor, and global
partnerships, accelerating access to next-generation therapies. By advancing novel and specialty
therapies with clear clinical relevance, we aim to improve patient outcomes while strengthening
Glenmark’s position as a global, innovation-led pharmaceutical company. 

Accessibility is embedded into how we develop, manufacture, and deliver medicines. Through scalable
manufacturing, fair pricing models, and differentiated delivery formats, we work to make
high-quality therapies across diverse healthcare segments, especially in markets where access
remains limited.

## We are GMP+ International

GMP+ International is the world’s largest scheme for safe and sustainable animal feed. Our mission
is to enable every company in the feed chain to take responsibility for working in a safe and

After contaminated feed caused several serious incidents, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) was set

## Our chain approach


The strength of our scheme lies in our unique chain approach. Safe and sustainable feed can only be
achieved when companies work together as a coherence within the feed chain. That's why all companies
from collection to production can be GMP+ certified. Because a chain is as strong as its weakest
link.

[ Collaborations ][61]

[Our chain approach]

## Benefits of GMP+ Certification

### Unique chain approach


GMP+ certified companies do business with companies which are likewise certified. Because all
companies work according to the same standards, we create a uniform chain from collection to
production.  

### HACCP and ISO


The GMP+ FC scheme has integrated HACCP and is based on ISO 22000 standards.

### A growing community


As a GMP+ certified company, you are part of a growing and committed community of over 19,000
companies in 87 countries. GMP+ certified companies enjoy a very solid reputation for being reliable
and committed to feed safety.

### Independent audits


GMP+ certified companies are audited yearly by auditors working for independent Certification
Bodies.

[ Benefits ][62]

At GMP+ International we believe that sharing knowledge is a prerequisite for a safe and sustainable
feed chain. Please sign up for our newsletters with information about our scheme, training
opportunities, sector developments, feed legislation and more. In this way you are always informed.

## We are GMP+ International

GMP+ International is the world’s largest scheme for safe and sustainable animal feed. Our mission
is to enable every company in the feed chain to take responsibility for working in a safe and
sustainable way.

After contaminated feed caused several serious incidents, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) was set
up by the Dutch feed industry in 1992 as a certification scheme for feed safety. Today, GMP+
International is a not-for-profit with over 20,000 [GMP+ certified companies][51] in 90 countries. 

[More about GMP+ International ][52]

[Image]
[Image]

## GMP+ Feed Certification scheme

The GMP+ Feed Certification (GMP+ FC) scheme provides internationally recognised standards to
produce safe feed, and a growing set of international standards for sustainable feed.

Go directly to: 
[GMP+ Feed Safety Assurance (GMP+ FSA][53][)][54]

[GMP+ Feed Responsibility Assurance (GMP+ FRA)][55]

[More about our scheme][56]

## Our chain approach


The strength of our scheme lies in our unique chain approach. Safe and sustainable feed can only be
achieved when companies work together as a coherence within the feed chain. That's why all companies
from collection to production can be GMP+ certified. Because a chain is as strong as its weakest
link.

[ Collaborations ][61]

[Our chain approach]

## Benefits of GMP+ Certification

### Unique chain approach


GMP+ certified companies do business with companies which are likewise certified. Because all
companies work according to the same standards, we create a uniform chain from collection to
production.  

### HACCP and ISO


The GMP+ FC scheme has integrated HACCP and is based on ISO 22000 standards.

### A growing community


As a GMP+ certified company, you are part of a growing and committed community of over 19,000
companies in 87 countries. GMP+ certified companies enjoy a very solid reputation for being reliable
and committed to feed safety.

### Independent audits


GMP+ certified companies are audited yearly by auditors working for independent Certification
Bodies.

[ Benefits ][62]

## Subscribe to our newsletters


At GMP+ International we believe that sharing knowledge is a prerequisite for a safe and sustainable
feed chain. Please sign up for our newsletters with information about our scheme, training
opportunities, sector developments, feed legislation and more. In this way you are always informed.

orphan drug sourcing to clinical trial supply and government pharmaceutical programs — we deliver

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

### Specialization

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

Is it really free? What's the business model?

Distributors, importers, wholesalers and sales agents use the platform completely free, browse,
build a profile, send introduction requests. Manufacturers can claim their listing and receive
requests for free too. We plan to offer optional paid features for manufacturers who want promoted
placement and advanced reach, but the core marketplace stays free for both sides.

Who can see my contact details and company information?

Your direct contact information, email, phone, address, is never shown publicly. It's only shared
with a specific counterpart after both sides agree to the introduction. Your company profile (name,
location, categories, description) is public and helps the right partners find you.

How quickly can I realistically expect a first connection?

Distributors with a complete profile and a clear target category typically hear back within a few
days of sending their first request. Manufacturers with detailed profiles and active distribution
offers usually receive their first inbound request within 2-4 weeks. Response speed depends on both
sides, we notify immediately by email so nothing sits unseen.

Can I use the platform in my own language?

Yes. The interface is available in 17 languages, use the language switcher on any page. In your
dashboard you can write your profile, offers and product descriptions in your own language and
translate them to English in one click. Catalog content is also shown machine-translated in several
major languages.

## At Hetero, our every action seeks to inspire human belief in accessibility and affordability of
## life-saving medicines across the world.

With unparalleled strengths in pharmaceutical research, manufacturing, and marketing, we are
positioned to serve people regardless of geographies. Our new identity embodies this drive to expand
our reach and capabilities in order to respond with agility to the world’s evolving health needs.
Our every action seeks to inspire human belief in accessibility and affordability of life-saving
medicines across the world.

## Partnering with MPP to expand access of nirmatrelvir & ritonavir generics for COVID-19 treatment

To ensure significant increase in access to COVID-19 treatments for all people, particularly those
living in the poorest parts of the world.

Demonstrated that Molnupiravir along with Standard of Care (SOC) reduced the risk of hospitalization

## Built for businesses that need both filings and strategy

Most businesses in India choose between two kinds of partner. Filing platforms are fast and cheap,
but they will not advise you on a market entry, a transaction, or an audit. Boutique consulting
firms are strong on strategy, but they will not file your GSTR-3B or push your DIR-3 KYC. KAMRIT
does both.

That works because KAMRIT is structured as a financial services LLP with capability across
registration, tax, audit, and corporate compliance, and it operates alongside our sister firm
Claight (same directors, same shareholders) which publishes research, analytics, and procurement
intelligence across nineteen industries. Filings flow into advisory. Advisory flows into filings.
One partner is accountable.

## What that gets you
* **Volume work without the platform cost.** Private Limited Company registration starts at ₹4,899.
  GST returns from ₹699 a month. Trademark filing at ₹4,899. All fixed fee.
* **Strategic work without the Big-Four price.** India entry, feasibility studies, GTM strategy,
  M&A, and transfer pricing engagements led by senior partners.
* **Research at your shoulder.** Claight market intelligence informs our India entry and GTM work,
  used by clients across SaaS, manufacturing, healthcare, and consumer goods.
* **A single calendar across regulators.** ROC, FEMA, RBI, GST, Income Tax, PF, ESI, Shops Act, all
  owned, filed, and reported on monthly.

Frequently asked

## Quick answers from our experts.

What services does KAMRIT offer?

KAMRIT offers the complete India advisory stack. Company registration (Private Limited, LLP, OPC,
Section 8, Producer, Nidhi), GST registration and returns, income tax and TDS, MCA and ROC
compliance, trademark and IP, payroll and labour, audit and assurance, plus India entry, GTM
strategy, M&A advisory, and FEMA / RBI work.

How is KAMRIT different from IndiaFilings or a typical CA firm?

Two ways. First, we run both the filings (like a platform) and the strategic advisory (like a
consulting firm) under one roof, so a Private Limited Company registration can flow into a GTM
strategy and an audited annual return without changing vendors. Second, KAMRIT and our sister firm
Claight share directors and shareholders, which means our India entry, market sizing, and
procurement intelligence work sits on top of the same research feeds Fortune 500 strategy and
procurement teams already use.

How much does company registration cost in India?

KAMRIT registers a Private Limited Company starting at ₹4,899, an LLP starting at ₹3,899, a One
Person Company at ₹3,899, and a Sole Proprietorship at ₹1,899. Pricing is fixed-fee and inclusive of
MCA name approval, MOA and AOA drafting, incorporation, PAN, TAN, and bank account opening
assistance.

How long does GST registration take?

A standard GST registration takes seven to ten working days from document submission, subject to the
GSTN officer's processing time. KAMRIT files within one business day of receiving complete documents
and tracks every notification end to end.

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits

des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de

[Custom Carrageenan Solution ][99]

Carrageenan is a widely used natural seaweed colloid in the food, daily chemical, pharmaceutical,
and industrial raw material markets. As a water-soluble polysaccharide extracted from natural red
algae, it possesses multiple functions including thickening, gelling, stabilizing, suspending, and
water retention, making it an indispensable food-grade additive in the production of dairy products,
meat products, jelly beverages, and personal care products. Many processing plants often encounter
problems when purchasing carrageenan, such as selecting the wrong type, finished product
stratification, poor gel texture, and large batch-to-batch performance fluctuations. Ultimately,
this stems from the lack of a carrageenan solution tailored to their specific production lines.

06 Jul 2026
[Unlocking the Potential of Gelatin: A Natural Hydrocolloid for Superior Texture ][101]

Gelatin is a natural, high-molecular-weight polypeptide derived from collagen found in animal skin,
bones, tendons, and other connective tissues. Through a partial hydrolysis process, the
characteristic triple helix structure of collagen is disrupted, resulting in gelatin that is soluble
in hot water. Gelatin typically appears as translucent, pale yellow to amber granules or sheets, and
is odorless and tasteless. This neutral sensory profile allows it to be widely used in various food
and pharmaceutical products without interfering with their original flavors. As a biomaterial with a
long history of human use, the research and application of gelatin are highly advanced. Its unique
physicochemical properties have secured it an irreplaceable position in the food industry,
pharmaceuticals, health products, cosmetics, and even the photographic industry.

environmental sustainability.

[ [Custom Carrageenan Solution] ][98]
07 Jul 2026
[Custom Carrageenan Solution ][99]

Carrageenan is a widely used natural seaweed colloid in the food, daily chemical, pharmaceutical,
and industrial raw material markets. As a water-soluble polysaccharide extracted from natural red
algae, it possesses multiple functions including thickening, gelling, stabilizing, suspending, and
water retention, making it an indispensable food-grade additive in the production of dairy products,
meat products, jelly beverages, and personal care products. Many processing plants often encounter
problems when purchasing carrageenan, such as selecting the wrong type, finished product
stratification, poor gel texture, and large batch-to-batch performance fluctuations. Ultimately,
this stems from the lack of a carrageenan solution tailored to their specific production lines.

LEARN MORE
[ [Unlocking the Potential of Gelatin: A Natural Hydrocolloid for Superior Texture] ][100]
06 Jul 2026
[Unlocking the Potential of Gelatin: A Natural Hydrocolloid for Superior Texture ][101]

Gelatin is a natural, high-molecular-weight polypeptide derived from collagen found in animal skin,
bones, tendons, and other connective tissues. Through a partial hydrolysis process, the
characteristic triple helix structure of collagen is disrupted, resulting in gelatin that is soluble
in hot water. Gelatin typically appears as translucent, pale yellow to amber granules or sheets, and
is odorless and tasteless. This neutral sensory profile allows it to be widely used in various food
and pharmaceutical products without interfering with their original flavors. As a biomaterial with a
long history of human use, the research and application of gelatin are highly advanced. Its unique
physicochemical properties have secured it an irreplaceable position in the food industry,
pharmaceuticals, health products, cosmetics, and even the photographic industry.

01 Jul 2026
[Why Formulators Are Switching to Gellan Gum ][103]

The plant‑based revolution has created a problem: how do you replicate gelatin's unique texture
without animal ingredients? Agar agar is brittle. Carrageenan can be tricky with dairy. Pectin
doesn't work across pH ranges. But there is one solution that ticks all the boxes – and it comes
from bacterial fermentation, not animal bones.

Sausage casings play a critical role in defining the quality, appearance, and eating experience of
sausage products. The choice between natural and collagen casings is one of the most consequential
decisions in sausage production, affecting everything from production efficiency to consumer
perception .

### About our parent company

[ [Sekhmet_Logo] ][47]

In May 2022, [Sekhmet Pharmaventures][48] acquired a majority stake in Optimus Drugs Group of
Companies, marking a pivotal step in our evolution.

Sekhmet Pharmaventures Pvt. Ltd. (part of Gamot API Pte Ltd. based in Singapore) was formed by Asian
private equity major PAG, along with Indian private equity firms, CX Partners and Samara Capital.
The three has formed an investment platform called Gamot API Pte. Ltd. based in Singapore, with the
aim to buy stakes in fast-growing pharma companies. Sekhmet Pharmaventures continues to combine
inorganic endeavors together with organic growth activities, in order to form a leading Pharma
platform in the spaces of intermediates, API, Finished Dosage Formulations and CMO & CDMO services.

## Frequently asked questions

What does Optimus do?
Optimus is a leading Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), delivering
comprehensive, end-to-end solutions from clinical development to commercial manufacturing of Key
Starting Materials(KSMs), Regulatory Starting Materials(RSMs), Advanced Intermediates, Drug
Substances and Drug Products to the global innovative biotech and pharmaceutical companies.
In which areas does Optimus specialise?

Optimus specialises in:
* Exclusive development and manufacturing of Late phase Molecules.
* Custom Manufacturing of KSM’s, RSMs and Advanced Intermediates.
* Backward integration of KSM’s / Intermediates
* Development and Manufacturing of Oral Solids / Semi Solids dosage forms

How does Optimus ensure quality and compliance?
Quality is maintained through stringent standards in R&D and manufacturing, supported by strong
regulatory understanding, IP management, and robust process development, validation, and
tech-transfer capabilities.
What is the scale of manufacturing capacity?
Optimus provides flexible manufacturing capacity from gram-scale to multi-tonne production,
supporting efficient and cost-effective scale-up of complex molecules and niche molecules.
Does Optimus support custom API or formulation development?
Yes. With a team of 150+ scientists and advanced facilities, Optimus offers custom process
development, analytical method validation, tech transfer, and commercial scale-up for both drug
substances and drug products.
What are the advantages of partnering with Optimus?
* 20+ years of industry expertise
* Integrated backward manufacturing offering cost advantage
* High-quality R&D for complex and niche molecules
* Global export capability and regulatory readiness
* Focus on innovation, affordability, and excellence
Can Optimus support technology transfer or process validation?
Yes. Our expertise team has extensive experience in both technology transfer from a third party
manufacturing site as well as process validations under strict quality and regulatory frameworks.
How does Optimus handle regulatory compliance and documentation?
All submissions are supported with complete documentation such as ANDA / DMFs / IMPD , technical
packages, validation reports, and CMC data to facilitate multi-market regulatory filings.
Does Optimus offer finished formulations or only APIs?
Optimus offers both drug substance and drug products developed through its dedicated formulation R&D
and manufacturing units.

## Frequently asked questions

What does Optimus do?
Optimus is a leading Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), delivering
comprehensive, end-to-end solutions from clinical development to commercial manufacturing of Key
Starting Materials(KSMs), Regulatory Starting Materials(RSMs), Advanced Intermediates, Drug
Substances and Drug Products to the global innovative biotech and pharmaceutical companies.
In which areas does Optimus specialise?

Optimus specialises in:
* Exclusive development and manufacturing of Late phase Molecules.
* Custom Manufacturing of KSM’s, RSMs and Advanced Intermediates.
* Backward integration of KSM’s / Intermediates
* Development and Manufacturing of Oral Solids / Semi Solids dosage forms

How does Optimus ensure quality and compliance?
Quality is maintained through stringent standards in R&D and manufacturing, supported by strong
regulatory understanding, IP management, and robust process development, validation, and
tech-transfer capabilities.
What is the scale of manufacturing capacity?
Optimus provides flexible manufacturing capacity from gram-scale to multi-tonne production,
supporting efficient and cost-effective scale-up of complex molecules and niche molecules.
Does Optimus support custom API or formulation development?
Yes. With a team of 150+ scientists and advanced facilities, Optimus offers custom process
development, analytical method validation, tech transfer, and commercial scale-up for both drug
substances and drug products.
What are the advantages of partnering with Optimus?
* 20+ years of industry expertise
* Integrated backward manufacturing offering cost advantage
* High-quality R&D for complex and niche molecules
* Global export capability and regulatory readiness
* Focus on innovation, affordability, and excellence
Can Optimus support technology transfer or process validation?
Yes. Our expertise team has extensive experience in both technology transfer from a third party
manufacturing site as well as process validations under strict quality and regulatory frameworks.
How does Optimus handle regulatory compliance and documentation?
All submissions are supported with complete documentation such as ANDA / DMFs / IMPD , technical
packages, validation reports, and CMC data to facilitate multi-market regulatory filings.
Does Optimus offer finished formulations or only APIs?
Optimus offers both drug substance and drug products developed through its dedicated formulation R&D
and manufacturing units.

### About Conference



**Conference Series!!** Cordially invites participants from all over the world to
attend **“[4^{th} World Congress on Pharmaceutics, Formulations & Novel Drug Delivery
Systems][77]”** with a theme of  **“*Futuristic Scope of Next Generation Drug Delivery on Pharma
Industry*”** scheduled during **November** 1**3-14, 2023** at **Barcelona, Spain.**

The event offers a best platform with its well organized scientific program to the audience which
includes interactive panel discussions, keynote lectures, plenary talks and poster Sessions.
Pharmaceutics & Drug Delivery Systems is a global platform to discuss and learn about research
Advances in Drug Delivery Research, [Drug Targeting and Design][78], Nano medicine &
Nanotechnology, [Pharmaceutical Technology][79], Medicinal Chemistry and Drug Discovery, Novel Drug
Delivery Systems, Pre-formulation & formulation  aspects, Bio pharmaceutics and Biologic Drugs.

The conference invites Directors, Group Leaders, Professors, Associate Professors, Lecturers,
Research Associates, Scientists, Investigators,  business delegates from Leading Universities,

professionals, across the globe providing a better podium, interconnecting the latest research,
technological development

# Aseptische Verpackungs­lösungen für flüssige Produkte von Rommelag

Als **Erfinder der Blow-Fill-Seal (BFS) Technologie** ist Rommelag Ihr zuverlässiger
One-Stop-Partner für aseptische Verpackungs­lösungen für Ihre flüssigen Produkte. Neben unseren
leistungs­starken bottelpack Abfüllanlagen bieten wir Lohnabfüll­dienst­leistungen, Unterstützung bei
der Produkt­entwicklung sowie ein umfassendes Service­angebot für alle Ihre Verpackungs­anforderungen.

Technologie

## BFS-Technologie & bottelpack-Abfüllanlagen

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

# Leading Global Pharmaceutical Company

Salvavidas Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is committed to being the world’s leading manufacturer and
exporter of finished dosage forms (FDFs) and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs). Our main goal
is to improve patient outcomes while establishing industry-defining standards. We strive to produce
necessary drugs that are affordable, easily available, and effective.

## We are offering
## best Services & Products

High-quality pharmaceutical, ayurvedic, and antibiotic medications are available from Salvavidas
Pharmaceutical, a well-known pharmaceutical manufacturer and supplier in India. Customers can choose
from a variety of packaging solutions for their items, and flexible payment alternatives. They
guarantee on-time delivery and keep their prices competitive. Salvavidas Pharmaceutical puts the
needs of its patients first by improving safety, efficacy, convenience, and compliance while
offering reasonably priced goods that benefit both patients and society as a whole.
* 
  
  We Committed to Quality Products
* 
  
  WHO-GMP & ISO Certified Facilities

## We Committed for a Better Life

### Salvavidas pharma is a leading pharmaceutical manufacturing and export company in India

We place a high priority on customer happiness, which we accomplish by offering high-quality
medicines on schedule and at fair prices. We promise that every product meets the highest caliber
throughout its development, manufacturing, sale, distribution, etc. We are dedicated to establishing
and preserving solid bonds with our clients worldwide. As a result, we are now recognized as a
reliable exporter offering service globally.

## What we bring to you

Salvavidas Pharma is a well-known Indian pharmaceutical exporter that provides a wide variety of
medications to international markets. The organization, which is based in Surat, Gujarat, is one of
the greatest places to find pharmaceutical items. It provides a wide range of products that are
developed to fulfill the requirements of its customers, such as antimalarials, analgesics, and
antibiotics. Salvavidas Pharma, which has a large worldwide presence, focuses on public health as a
driver for social and economic advancement. It is currently one of the leading pharmaceutical firms
in India.

Salvavidas Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. exports to more than 40 nations across five continents: Africa,
South-East Asia, Latin America, North America, and the CIS region. We are an Indian manufacturer and
exporter of all pharmaceutical items with more than 500 product registrations worldwide.
